coordinates.name: B_theta
coordinates.definition: Finite immutable learned description, including precision and encoding.

coordinates.name: B_static
coordinates.definition: Immutable interpreter, libraries, parser, renderer, verifier and index descriptions; charge once to named owner.

coordinates.name: B_mut_peak
coordinates.definition: Maximum simultaneously resident mutable state, including caches and proof state.

coordinates.name: B_mut_total
coordinates.definition: Cumulative newly written mutable bits; separate from retained peak.

coordinates.name: T_seq
coordinates.definition: Sequential depth/time in an explicitly named cost model.

coordinates.name: W_total
coordinates.definition: Sum of operations across parallel workers and retries.

coordinates.name: IO
coordinates.definition: All external input/output and retrieved content, including intermediate model tokens under an encoding.

coordinates.name: BW
coordinates.definition: Peak/average communication rate, both window and statistic declared.

coordinates.name: V_cost
coordinates.definition: Verifier execution plus construction/acquisition, separate from solver work; information privilege enumerated.

coordinates.name: train_cost
coordinates.definition: Training, data acquisition and preprocessing with amortization population and reuse horizon.

coordinates.name: Q_resource
coordinates.definition: Query, gate, ancilla, preparation, readout and fault-tolerance costs if quantum applies.

coordinates.name: energy_if_valid
coordinates.definition: Measured system-boundary energy with instrumentation; otherwise UNKNOWN, never zero.

comparability: Only common units, task/access/error/precision and explicit all-coordinate accounting admit Pareto comparison; UNKNOWN blocks domination claims.
non_compensatory: Stronger uncharged oracle or verifier labels invalidate parity.
Parser, preprocessing and retrieval are never free by relocation.
Positive measured counts require exact units and source; zero still requires evaluated denominator.
A finite calibration is not an all-size simulation theorem.
remaining: Full matched manifests for fixed/recurrent Transformer, SSM, NTM/DNC, retrieval and OCM.
Independent accounting audit and compiled simulation witness.
